full_first_text.title: The top bar
body: The plane is airplane mode: filled means offline, and nothing leaves this machine until you turn it off and agree to what will be contacted. The language menu switches the whole interface at once. The task manager shows what is running, queued and scheduled.
The tour changes nothing: it sets no filter, hides no tab and keeps no record.

full_last.title: Your interface depth
body: The interface depth is Full now. A depth changes what is pinned in the sidebar, never what is reachable. You can change it in Settings, and take this tour again from there or from the command palette.
The tour changes nothing: it sets no filter, hides no tab and keeps no record.

essentials_more.title: 10 more tabs
body: At this depth they are grouped under “Show more” in the sidebar; the tab you have open always stays listed. They are all one click away, and the command palette (Ctrl/⌘-K) reaches every one of them.
The tour changes nothing: it sets no filter, hides no tab and keeps no record.

review.title: Export signed evidence
review.text:
The file is one signed JSON document: the articles you selected as provenance entries (where each came from and the SHA-256 of its text), bound together by a Merkle root and signed with this install's evidence key, so anyone can check that nothing was changed.

Articles: 6 · Sources: 3

What the file holds
manifest the bundle version, when it was made, the case name (your search query or the analysis label), how many articles, and the Merkle root that covers them
manifest.items one entry per article, with ⁦id, url, canonical_url, source_id, title, published_at, stored_hash, content_sha256⁩
signature, public_key the signature over the manifest and the public key that made it
algorithm the name of the signature scheme, ed25519

Plaintext: the file is not encrypted. It lists each article's address, title and date, and anyone who has the file can read them. The articles' text is not in it, only its SHA-256.

The case name written in the file, readable by anyone who has it: ⁨glacier⁩

This install has no evidence key yet. One is created on this machine when you save, and stays here. It proves this install made a bundle, and links every bundle it signs.

done.text:
Handed to your browser as ⁨evidence-bundle-2026-09-30.json⁩: 6 articles, ⁨3.2 KB⁩. Your browser chooses where it goes and may rename it.

What the file holds
manifest the bundle version, when it was made, the case name (your search query or the analysis label), how many articles, and the Merkle root that covers them
manifest.items one entry per article, with ⁦id, url, canonical_url, source_id, title, published_at, stored_hash, content_sha256⁩
signature, public_key the signature over the manifest and the public key that made it
algorithm the name of the signature scheme, ed25519

Signing key (Ed25519), to give the recipient some other way: 67d570dea7d75be30c6b9cd61fecddb58f67e41b8a2a11110e621823b52b4d82

Anyone can check the file offline with scripts/verify_evidence.py, which needs only the file and the key.
